TAKES TOO LONG TO LOAD. Hi, I’ve used your app for a long time. The tuner functions wonderfully. And looks great. But my massive complaint with it is IT’s JUST A SIMPLE TUNER! It’s critical as a musician and music teacher that I need to be able to reliably pull my phone out in a pinch and know that I can tune quickly and get back to teaching or playing. It upsets me to know and when I click on that and sometimes it will just sit there and load for like up to 45 seconds. In truth it might only be like 25 or 30 seconds. But it is still infuriating. I really prefer the function and display of your app more than other tuning apps but the loading time is just so annoying! I feel like your app is just too bloated, nobody wants to play along to Green Day after they tune they just want a tuner. And also I totally understand this one but I wish you could make your paywall elsewhere or not have to scroll through it. That one’s fair I don’t really mind it but yeah the initial loading time is in my opinion just unacceptable.
